svg.aria-label: The general packs: from a catalogue to their tools and what they reach
svg.title: The general packs: from a catalogue to their tools and what they reach

g.text: from a catalogue to their tools and what they reach
what it needs and its tools
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: A pack is only its tools:
the engine stays in charge of what's dangerous. The web pack's calls go through the engine's
guards, so a pack can't reach an internal address.
